facts.text: Melanie and Caroline both helped create a painting of a sunset with a palm tree, which was completed during a session on 15 July 2023.

evidence.quote: We love painting together lately, especially nature-inspired ones. Here's our latest work from last weekend.
Thanks, Caroline! We both helped with the painting - it was great bonding over it and chatting about nature.

facts.text: Melanie and Caroline found flowers while working on a creative project, which they appreciated as a way to focus on the small things in life.

evidence.quote: We found these lovely flowers. Appreciating the small things in life, too.

facts.text: Caroline and Melanie bonded over their shared love of nature, which was reflected in their creative projects.

evidence.quote: The colors are so bold and it really highlights the beauty of nature.
So glad you bonded over our love of nature.

facts.text: Caroline attended a council meeting for adoption on the previous Friday, which was both inspiring and emotional, and made her more determined to adopt.

evidence.quote: Last Friday I went to a council meeting for adoption. It was inspiring and emotional - so many people wanted to create loving homes for children in need. It made me even more determined to adopt.
